policy: Only CC0 assets, each checked on its original source page. Nothing is fetched at runtime; every file below is served locally from this folder.
original: Game design, levels, rivals, rules, scoring and simulation (src/features/games/longbow).
Bow, arrows, target faces, straw boss, target stands, swing and slide rigs, wind flags, distance markers, trees, hay bales, mesas and sky (procedural Three.js geometry and canvas textures).
Draw creak, miss thud and bell chimes (WebAudio synthesis).
cover.png: rendered from the game itself (Pinewood lane), no external artwork.
